Contrast accessors

Source: R/accessors.R
contrastAccessors.Rd

Return how a result was obtained: the coefficients of the contrast, the two groups it compares, the cut-offs its labels were set at, and, for tiled counts, how the tiles were combined into their region.

Usage

contrastVector(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.results'
contrastVector(results)

contrastGroups(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.results'
contrastGroups(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.setResults'
contrastGroups(results)

thresholdInfo(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.results'
thresholdInfo(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.setResults'
thresholdInfo(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.geneResults'
thresholdInfo(results)

tileCombination(results)

# S4 method for class 'RegionSetDE.results'
tileCombination(results)

Arguments

results

RegionSetDE.results object returned by testRegions. contrastGroups also takes a RegionSetDE.setResults object, and thresholdInfo a RegionSetDE.setResults or RegionSetDE.geneResults object.

Value

contrastVector returns the coefficients of the contrast over the columns of the design. contrastGroups returns a list with the column of the colData the contrast separates and the two groups it compares, the first being the level the fold change is positive for, and for a per-region result n.samples, the number of samples in each; the list is empty when the contrast is not a difference between two levels of one variable. thresholdInfo returns a named list with the cut-offs, such as FDR and log2FC, and the correction method, adjust.method. tileCombination returns a list with the method that combined the tiles of each region, empty when the counts were not tiled.

See also

contrastName, contrastInfo, updateThresholds

Author

Sebastian Gregoricchio

Examples

fit <- loadExampleData("fit", verbose = FALSE)
results <- testRegions(fit, contrast = c("condition", "SHR", "BN"), verbose = FALSE)

contrastVector(results)
#>  (Intercept) conditionSHR 
#>            0            1 
contrastGroups(results)
#> $column
#> [1] "condition"
#> 
#> $groups
#> [1] "SHR" "BN" 
#> 
#> $n.samples
#> SHR  BN 
#>   2   2 
#> 
thresholdInfo(results)
#> $FDR
#> [1] 0.05
#> 
#> $log2FC
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $lfcThreshold
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $adjust.method
#> [1] "BH"
#> 
tileCombination(results)
#> $applied
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $method
#> [1] NA
#>
